name: Hoskinds Hardwoods
old_description: Welcome to Hoskinds Hardwoods We are a family-owned and operated, veteran-owned company nestled in the beautiful Ozark Mountains of Arkansas. We are a custom woodshop that specializes in creating rustic designed furniture, accessories, home decor, and offers laser engraving services.  Be sure to browse our website and gallery to find unique items that showcase our craftsmanship. Additionally, we provide sawmill, dry kiln services, and moulding and trim work to meet all your woodworking needs
about:
Hoskinds Hardwoods is based in Marshall, Arkansas, nestled in the Ozark Mountains. The business is family-owned and operated and veteran-owned. The founding year and founders’ names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop functions as a custom woodshop, producing rustic-designed furniture, accessories, and home decor. It also offers laser engraving, sawmill operations, dry kiln drying, and moulding and trim work. No details on facility size, employee count, or production volumes are provided.

The company markets its products and services to individuals and businesses with woodworking needs, including furniture, custom milling, and finishing. No specific industry sectors or named customers are identified in the available information.

Hoskinds Hardwoods states that it believes every home deserves a touch of rustic charm, and that its handcrafted pieces are made with the finest materials to ensure quality, durability, and style.
